methodology.request_latency: resampling + feature preparation + encoders + decoding + text conversion; excludes model loading, file I/O and oracle checks
methodology.inference_latency: target encoder + draft encoder when used + decoder; includes synchronization at stage boundaries
methodology.quantiles: across per-utterance medians of repeated measurements; descriptive on small samples
methodology.throughput: serial batch-size-1 replay; generated tokens include EOS; not concurrent serving throughput
methodology.memory: all paths have both models resident; extra peak is above resident allocated CUDA memory
methodology.quality: exact tokens vs shared target greedy policy; WER lowercases and removes punctuation
methodology.profiling: separate instrumented run, excluded from headline benchmark
